card.name: Who profits or is subsidized (political essays)
card.fires_on: Words about money or benefit flowing to some group, such as subsidize, subsidy, profit, flow, serve, or for, in political or economic opinion writing. It often sits just before the beneficiary is named.

modes.label: Subsidy words
modes.description: Forms of subsidize or subsidy in critiques of who gets public money.

modes.label: Benefit-flow verbs and links
modes.description: Verbs or small linking words that say benefit goes to someone, just before the recipient.
modes.example: the benefits of its consumption would continue to<< flow>> to unsavory dictators

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about who gains or gets money, such as rich, transfer, or give to.
card.plain: It marks spots in political essays where money or benefit is about to be said to go to some group.
